name: Read Aloud
title: Read Aloud: free Speechify alternative
hook: Speechify charges you a hundred and thirty nine dollars a year to read articles out loud. This does it for free.

features.intro: Open any article and tap the icon.
features.say: It reads the page out loud, and can highlight each sentence.
Or select some text, right click, and hear just that.

install: Download from the Chrome Web Store
install_line: It runs on Chrome, Firefox and Edge. Just add the free extension from your browser's store.
caption:
Speechify charges $139/year to read articles out loud. Read Aloud does it for free 🔊

✅ Reads any webpage out loud with one click
✅ Highlights the text as it reads
✅ Select text, right click, and hear just that
✅ Free and open source, no subscription

💻 Chrome · Firefox · Edge
ℹ️ The built-in browser voices are free. Premium voices like Google Wavenet and Amazon Polly need your own Google Cloud or AWS API key, and some cloud voices may need an in-app purchase. Speechify Premium is $139/year billed yearly (or $29 a month)

Comment "READ" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
